QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Source of Magic
QuestInfo.0: You found Rius at #m300010200#, carefully studying a Stone Golem. Why would he be doing something like that?
QuestInfo.1: You must collect #b#e100 Stone Bug Rubbles#n#k for Rius.\n\nStone Bugs can be found at #m300010100# and #m300010200#.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 100 Stone Bug Rubbles to Rius, and he said that he'll continue his research back at camp, since Sion is so worried.\nReturn to Altaire Camp.

0.0: Initially, I thought it would be great to use these enchanted stones to protect the camp. However...I became very curious of how life energy gets trapped inside them.
0.1: I got so caught up in studying #o5250001# that I completely forgot about contacting Sion. Shame on me!
0.2: Kao, do you think you could help me out?

yes.0: Thanks. Bring me the Rubble from those Stone Bugs. With enough of them, I think I can figure out how these stones really work.

no.0: Look, this is important. If you don't want to do it for me...do it for Sion.

1.0: Did you bring me 100 #t4000439# items? Serious research calls for a lot of materials!
1.1: This should be enough. And don't worry, I'll be taking these back to Altaire Camp, and studying them there. Don't want to worry Sion any more than I already have, huh? Thanks for your help, Kao. You should get back to camp, too.

item.0: I really need that #t4000439#, Kao. I just know there's some secret locked away inside...
